# Patched renderer

This workspace pins the common Dioxus 0.7.10 WebView reconnect patches at
`2190779e1c0ce2e10e54178b1dceb57c02bedc38`. The patch remains independent of app and study-library releases.
See the [source and upgrade notes](https://github.com/MohamedRef/study-libs/blob/2190779e1c0ce2e10e54178b1dceb57c02bedc38/vendor/README.md)
for the behavior, upstream licenses and verification.
